verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software or developer platform, so official SDKs are a category error for this kind of product. Its client tools (the Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O portal) are end-user web portals. ChatGD is an internal attorney tool built on Azure OpenAI. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm shipping a developer SDK or API that would make this axis apply, and the probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
